_doc: Shared parity table for the stranded-husk predicate (2026-10-10, docs/research/lr-stranded-husk-2026-10-10/round2/C2.md D). Read by ONE bats loop (tests/lr-lib.bats, the shell lr_successor_state) and ONE pytest (scripts/limit-recover/lr_recon/tests/test_census.py, census.successor_state); both must give `expect`, the first token of the answer, or null for no durable move (shell rc 1 or rc 2). Stores: src=.claude-secondary, tgt=.claude-quaternary, ter=.claude-tertiary. A holder with a pane is a live registry row; one without is a bare `claude --resume <sid>` process; cfg none is a live holder whose account cannot be read. Pane ids are non-numeric on purpose: the shell's lr_husk_state reads the REAL process table for a `__recycle <pane>` watcher, and a numeric id can collide with a live pane. Not in the table, by design: in-flight (the census has no handoffs log) and a move known only by its transplant lock (the census reads no locks).
